complexity_rationale: Web-only. Composes UC-014 primitives (CustomerMapShell/full-bleed map, BottomSheet, CameraController) + existing tracking hooks/logic (useTrackingAuthed/useTrackingPublic/trackingMode, headlineRules, selectCarMarker/trackingMarker, usePositionStore, useFleetHub, useCancelOrder/useRateOrder/RatingForm/StarPicker, PushPrompt). No backend change (all realtime/tracking endpoints exist). Moderate.
key_constraints: Replace TrackingPage presentation; keep route /customer/t/:code (authed + ?k=token public modes). Reuse ALL existing tracking hooks/logic + UC-014 shell/sheet/camera; do NOT rebuild them. Status-driven sheet via headlineRules (New/Assigned->Looking for drivers + Cancel; Accepted->driver+vehicle+ETA; Arrived; InProgress; Completed->summary+rating authed-only; Cancelled->back to /customer). Smooth driver-marker interpolation is a NEW pure tested module (prev+next+elapsed->coord; respect prefers-reduced-motion); no new heavy dep; leaflet stays lazy (no eager import). Public token-poll mode renders SAME UI, degrades gracefully (ETA null). Cancel only in state-machine-allowed states. i18n 6 locales formal 'vy'; money cs-CZ/Kc; dates Europe/Prague. Remove superseded presentational components+tests, no dangling refs. Update tracking e2e (cs-CZ). Axe on new interactive components; >=48px; focus/Escape on sheet+CancelDialog.
